question: Two men A and B, each working alone by working 12 hours per day, can complete a work in 20 days. For execution of the work, it was decided that A and B would be working for 8 and 6 hours per day, respectively, on alternate days starting with A. If it takes x days and y hours to complete the work then (x, y) is:
solution:

So, time taken by them to finish the entire work working on alternate days = 17 × 2 days 2 hours = 34 days 2 hours

∴ Then (x,y) is (34,2).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given:

Two men A and B, each working alone by working 12 hours per day, can complete a work in 20 days. 

A and B would be working for 8 and 6 hours per day, respectively, on alternate days starting with A. 

Concept used:

Entire work = Work done hourly × Time taken to finish the work

Calculation:

Let's suppose A and B do 1 unit of work hourly individually.

The entire work = 12 × 20 = 240 units

So, working on alternate days, A & B do 2 days = (8 + 6) = 14 units work

Hence, time taken to finish the work this way in set of 2 days = 240 ÷ 14 ≈ 17 (Here, we get a remainder of 2)

So, time taken by them to finish the entire work working on alternate days = 17 × 2 days 2 hours = 34 days 2 hours

**∴ Then (x,y) is (34,2).**
